feeds.title: Star Solaris Blog
feeds.description: Star Solaris explores the world of Reiki, a gentle Japanese healing technique that can help you achieve just that. Dive in and discover how Reiki can empower your journey towards a healthier, happier you. Lea Solaris Cesani is a Reiki Master imparting healing wisdom through her blog and Reiki services.

feeds.title: Desert Therapy Center Blog
feeds.description: Desert Therapy Center's blog provides information such as guided meditations, practices for mindfulness and nature connection, resources, and resources for empaths and highly sensitive people. Uncover the history and philosophy of Reiki, learn about its various applications, and discover how Reiki can help you manage stress.

feeds.title: Beth Budesheim Blog
feeds.description: Grab a handful of intuitive tips, guidance, and ways of becoming more whole along with advice on self-care, Soul care, finding your center, life balance, and becoming more of who you are. Beth Budesheim is a certified Energy Healer, RN, Artist, Intuitive, Soul Realignment® practitioner and many other roles.

feeds.title: Reveal The Heart Blog
feeds.description: Johnlyn Broeder, Energy Healer & Artist offers a holistic approach to well-being. Her blog delves into the principles of Reiki, explores its benefits for mind, body, and spirit, and provides insights on how you can integrate this practice into your life.

feeds.title: Rise: Tarot, Bread, Magic Blog
feeds.description: Find the magic in everything: intuitive tarot, healing reiki, integrative yoga, and artisan sourdough with RiSE. The latest post blog delves into the fascinating world of Distance Reiki, unpacking its principles, exploring its benefits, and offering practical guidance to help you harness its power and share the gift of Reiki healing with anyone, anywhere.
